messages:
maya: Quick design review — added inline annotations to the model catalog filters + a tiny tooltip copy tweak for version pin. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/model-catalog?node-id=42

maya: Key asks: 1) show lightweight collaborator comments on filter chips (like a dot + initials) 2) sticky compare header when you scroll right 3) update performance badge colors for WCAG contrast 4) pin tooltip copy should be action-oriented

jules: Nice. Can you paste the updated copy proposals here? want to sync with launch notes.

maya: Sure — current tooltip: "Pin this version". Proposal A: "Pin version for this route — overrides rollout". Proposal B (short): "Pin version (keep fixed)". Leaning toward A because it's explicit. Thoughts?

sam: For the sticky header, ok to use position: sticky on the compare-table container. caveat: horizontal scroll + sticky header + shadow need z-index tweaks. I can prototype if we align on markup.

alex: Re: badge contrast — current green token #22c55e fails at small sizes. Suggest using #16a34a for state or adding 2px outline for text. Also badges need aria-labels: e.g., aria-label="performance: 98th percentile latency" instead of just text.

lisa: From research, people understood "Pin" differently — many thought it was UI-level (like pin to favorites). The extra context in A helps. Also testers liked seeing who commented on filter chips — increased trust for shared teams.

maya: Updated annotation visuals: small 10px round avatar overlay on chip, hover reveals comment preview. Inline note: need to ensure avatar doesn't truncate chip label on small screens.

sam: Implement notes: we can render chips as flex with an overlay slot. CSS quick snippet: ```
.filter-chip { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; }
.filter-chip .avatar { width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%; margin-left:-6px; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg); }
```

sam: For small screens we hide avatars behind a single +N indicator, like "+2". keeps layout stable.

alex: Accessibility things to add: 1) chips should be buttons with role="button" and aria-pressed for toggle filters; 2) comment avatars need accessible names e.g., aria-label="comment from Maya"; 3) add keyboard focus ring for chip actions (not just outline).

jules: Good checklist. Also we need copy for empty state when no filters: maya/ux propose: "No filters applied — try pinned versions or search by model name". Maybe too wordy.

lisa: Testers preferred shorter: "No filters — try search or pin a version". prefer active verbs.

maya: Will update to: "No filters — search or pin a version to compare."

sam: About pin tooltip copy, I can make a microcopy variant test A/B with 5% traffic: A: "Pin version for this route — overrides rollout" B: "Pin version (keeps this model fixed)". both short enough.

jules: Let's A/B. also add small reminder in console header: "Pins override routing" (link to docs).

maya: One more visual nit: performance badge icon currently is a filled flame emoji-like glyph. Suggest switching to a circular progress micrograph for consistency with other metrics.

alex: If you swap icon, ensure it has aria-hidden="true" and the text description is in a visually-hidden span for screen readers.

sam: Implementation note: badge color tokens: --badge-success: #16a34a; --badge-warn: #f59e0b; --badge-danger: #dc2626. I'll run contrast checks and push a branch.

deploy-bot: Build queued for branch feature/catalog-chip-annotations (id: 1123) — tests running. :gear:

sam: FYI tests catching one flake in compare-table keyboard nav — fix incoming.

jules: Timeline: aim to have design sign-off by EOD tomorrow, dev prototype by Friday, and ship behind flag next week. can we commit to that?

maya: Yes. I'll update figma and post the final frames here when ready.

lisa: I'll draft the microcopy experiment and make sure the user study script includes clarity around "pin" mental model.

alex: I'll add an a11y checklist to the PR template for this feature.

maya: sweet. thanks all :sparkles:
